entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jewish cupbearer to the Persian king Artaxerxes who returned to Jerusalem as governor (c. 445 BCE) to rebuild the city walls. His leadership, organizing, and administrative reforms renewed Jerusalem as a functioning city and political center.
